title: HR email intake and coordination observations
summary: Initial, privacy-safe observations from the HR mailbox and former HR manager archives. These are process leads for validation, not instructions for handling current cases.

claims.claim: In September 2026, the HR inbox received repeated notifications for employment application form submissions. This suggests the online form is one channel for applicant intake; its relationship to ADP and the full review workflow remains to be verified.

evidence.note: Application response content and applicant identity are excluded.

claims.claim: HR correspondence includes coordination to collect missing new-hire information before benefits paperwork can be completed. The responsible parties, required documents, system of record, and sequence need confirmation from position-level sources.

evidence.note: Employee identity and the requested personal information are excluded. This single-case message does not establish a universal process.

claims.claim: A 2017 handbook discussion described the insurance section as applying after 60 days, consistent at a high level with the 2025 handbook's 60-day eligibility language. The email does not establish the complete effective-date formula or current plan rules.

evidence.note: Historical email evidence only; the 2025 handbook remains the current position-level source. No employee case details are retained.

claims.claim: A 2017–2020 scan of former HR manager archives surfaced recurring handbook, policy, EEO, FMLA, ADP/payroll, benefit enrollment, training, and audit topics. This establishes a source map for further historical process research, not the content or currentness of any rule.
